Nina Flores: Sharing a compact iteration of the Private/VPC setup wizard networking step. Goals: reduce cognitive load, make remediation actionable, and improve accessibility. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012. Can we surface quick fixes for non-network folks? Ethan Park: Nice. Two quick UX asks: 1) show a short summary line under the stepper like '1 critical failure, 2 advisories' so users know severity at a glance; 2) rename the main CTA to 'Verify network health' (longer but clearer). Lina Gomez: From infra: preflight probes we run: DNS resolution, NAT egress, TLS handshake, port reachability, and model endpoint ping. Some probes can hang ~30s; we should show live streaming of results and let users cancel the run. Per-probe retry is useful. infra-bot: deployment: preflight-worker 2.2 rolled to staging at 2026-03-10T14:02:00Z Ethan Park: Copy tweak for failures: start with one-line impact: 'NAT egress failed 12: cannot reach Redwood pools' then give 2-3 remediation bullets with links to docs. Keep the raw output collapsed under 'Advanced details'. Lina Gomez: For advanced users include a small 'diagnostic commands' panel with a curl example and traceroute sample. Also add an idempotent probe id so support can replicate. a11y-bot: lint: badge--warning contrast 3.0:1 on 12px. recommend #92400E or add bold text. Nina Flores: Accessibility notes: don't rely on color alone; each status row should include an icon + text ('Passed / Advisory / Failed'). Add an aria-live status region to announce changes:
DNS check passed
. Keyboard behavior: after a failure, focus should move to the failing row and expand details. Ethan Park: UX nit: collapsing details must preserve focus order. Also add a small 'why this matters' tooltip for each critical check. Lina Gomez: Logging: capture start/end timestamps and probe RTTs. Expose a copy-log button in advanced details. Nina Flores: I'll update the frames with: summary line, Verify network health CTA, per-probe streaming + retry, aria-live region example, darker warning token, and collapsed advanced details including curl/traceroute. Will post new frames in ~1h. Please flag any remaining blockers. Ethan Park: I'll review the copy variants when posted. Lina Gomez: I'll validate the probe cancellation flow in staging once frames are up. Nina Flores: filed follow-ups: UX copy pick, a11y checklist, infra logging ticket. Thanks!
